en: Color photograph looking down a straight city street toward the sea. Mid‑rise apartment blocks line both sides, many with balconies and awnings, and numerous TV antennas on the roofs. A few cars from the mid‑20th century era drive along the street, which has small trees planted on the median or sidewalks. The sky is bright blue and the sea is visible at the far end of the avenue. No visible caption or printed text is present on the image side.
